integrity: All algebraic computations are exact over the rationals and replayed from the packaged verifier. Literature comparisons distinguish the named explicit component from general 2A1 quartic del Pezzo classifications.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the second prime component in the centipede-game example; no classification of arbitrary Spohn surfaces or real topology is claimed.
title: The excluded centipede component is a two-nodal quartic del Pezzo surface
